name: flyrank-ml-internship
title_zh: 十三份 FlyRank 机器学习实习任务包
tagline_zh: 想攒一段能写进简历的 ML 实习经历，却卡在没人给任务、没人验收？
tagline_en: Want an ML internship on your resume but no one hands you tasks? This pack splits FlyRank into 13 self-contained.
why_zh: 不是教程合集，是任务合集：13 个 skill 各自独立可跑，按实习节奏排好先后。
why_en: Not a tutorial dump but a task set: 13 independent, runnable skills ordered like a real internship, each ending in a showable.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 FlyRank 这一套实习任务，换公司或换课题就不适用；13 个 skill 需逐个安装。
limit_en: Covers only the FlyRank internship track; other companies or topics don't apply. Install the 13 skills one by one, and some tasks need the repo's.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。
